question: What divine emblems may be joined with the pole?
premises: The pole may be endowed with a trident.
The pole may alternatively be joined with the lord of gods.
inference: The pole may be accompanied either by a trident or by the lord of gods.
uncertainties: deveśena may refer to an image or emblem of the lord of gods
